observations.title: Trigger a Cataclysm dungeon introduction
observations.player_action: Approach an upstream-supported boss dungeon's intro trigger.
observations.outcome: The author describes one intro per dungeon for Scylla, Maledictus, Leviathan, Ancient Remnant and Ignis.
conditions: This is native external behavior, not proof the JEM hosted lifecycle permits it before Start.
External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: A cinematic activation is not boss defeat. JEM's dedicated encounter Start/dormancy owner takes precedence; native proximity cutscenes are not authorization to change that policy.
